title: How to Make Money on TikTok: Creator Fund, Creator Rewards, and Ways to Earn Without Followers
summary: Learn how to make money on TikTok with accurate details on the Creator Fund replacement, Creator Rewards payouts, TikTok Shop affiliate commissions, and how to earn without followers.
body_markdown:
## Every Way to Make Money on TikTok: What Each Method Actually Pays


Platform payouts are one route. Creator income can also come from viewer gifts, product commissions, paid brand work, or direct sales. Each method has different eligibility rules and payment terms, so check the offer details before treating a quoted rate as expected income.


### LIVE Gifts: Eligibility, Coins-to-Diamonds Math, and Payout Timing


[TikTok LIVE](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/tiktok-live-rewards-payout-explained-rates-calculator-and-how-to-withdraw-your-money) Viewers buy coins to send gifts; creators receive Diamonds based on TikTok’s conversion rules, with TikTok retaining a share before payout. Coin prices and conversion values mean a gift’s displayed value is not the creator’s cash earnings. Minimum withdrawals are commonly reported around $10, with payment often arriving about 30 days after the month in which earnings occurred. Check the current in-app terms.


### TikTok Shop Affiliate Commissions and Product Showcase Links


Affiliate creators feature eligible products and earn commission on qualifying sales attributed to their content or product links. Commission applies to sales under the offer’s terms, not video views. Review the rate, return rules, attribution window, and product availability before promoting an item.


### Brand Sponsorships and UGC Deals


Sponsored posts pay for agreed deliverables, while user-generated content (UGC) deals pay creators to produce content a business can use, sometimes without posting it to the creator’s account. Rates depend on scope, production requirements, usage rights, exclusivity, and revisions. Put deliverables and payment terms in writing, including whether the brand can run the video as an ad.


### Selling Your Own Products, Digital Goods, and Off-Platform Affiliate Offers


Creators can direct interested viewers to physical products, digital downloads, services, or affiliate offers outside TikTok, subject to platform rules and applicable disclosure requirements. Revenue depends on price, sales, fulfillment costs, and any commission arrangement. Calculate net income after production, platform or payment fees, refunds, and shipping rather than treating gross sales as take-home pay.


### Payout Reality Table: Requirements, Typical Pay, and Time to First Dollar


Compare routes by their payment mechanism, not an assumed paycheck. Exact earnings and timing depend on account eligibility, audience response, sales, and program terms. Follower count alone cannot predict income.


Method What determines earnings Requirements and timing


TikTok Shop affiliate Commission on qualifying product sales; commonly 5% to 20%+ Offer and account eligibility apply; earnings depend on attributed orders


Sponsorships or UGC Negotiated fee, deliverables, and usage rights Set by agreement; payment timing should be written into the contract


Own products or off-platform offers Sales and net margin after costs Depends on the offer, fulfillment, and payment terms


For planning, track actions you control: publish a defined offer, monitor clicks or orders, and calculate net earnings.
